summary: The AI model repository and deployment ecosystem in 2026 is highly concentrated, with Hugging Face dominating open-source model hosting at over 2 million models while specialized inference platforms like Together AI, Fireworks AI, and Replicate compete on cost, speed, and developer experience. Cloud hyperscalers like AWS Bedrock increasingly abstract away infrastructure concerns by offering managed access to top proprietary and open-weight models. Self-hosted and serverless options have proliferated, giving teams flexibility across privacy, cost, and scalability requirements.

platforms.name: Hugging Face
platforms.purpose: Central hub for hosting, discovering, and sharing open-source AI models, datasets, and Spaces (demo apps); the de facto standard repository for the open-source AI community
platforms.pricing: Free tier for public models and limited private repos; Pro plan at $9/month; Enterprise Hub from $20/user/month; Inference Endpoints billed per compute hour
features: Largest open-source model library with 2M+ models including Llama (476M cumulative downloads by March 2026), DeepSeek (128.2M downloads), Mistral (124.3M downloads), and Qwen
Model versioning, model cards, and community discussion threads
Hosted Inference API and dedicated Inference Endpoints on AWS, GCP, or Azure
Spaces for hosting Gradio and Streamlit demo apps
Dataset and evaluation leaderboard hosting
Fine-tuning support via AutoTrain
Top 200 models account for 49.6% of all downloads, showing high ecosystem concentration
Private model repos, SSO, and audit logs on Enterprise tier
platforms.best_for: Researchers, open-source contributors, and enterprises seeking the broadest model selection and community ecosystem for discovery, fine-tuning, and collaborative AI development

platforms.name: Ollama
platforms.purpose: Local model runner that allows developers to download and serve open-weight LLMs on their own hardware with a simple CLI and OpenAI-compatible API
platforms.model_count: 500+ curated models in official library (Llama, Mistral, Qwen, Phi, Gemma, DeepSeek, and more)
platforms.pricing: Free and open-source; costs limited to your own hardware or cloud VM expenses
features: One-command model pull and run (e.g., ollama run llama3)
OpenAI-compatible REST API for drop-in integration with existing tooling
Automatic model quantization (4-bit, 8-bit) to fit consumer hardware
Supports macOS (Metal), Linux, and Windows (including WSL2)
GPU acceleration via CUDA and Apple Silicon Metal
Model library with versioned tags and Modelfile customization
Integration with Open WebUI, LangChain, LlamaIndex, and AnythingLLM
No data leaves local machine, ensuring full privacy
platforms.best_for: Individual developers, privacy-conscious teams, and enterprises needing air-gapped or on-premise LLM inference without cloud dependencies

platforms.name: Replicate
platforms.purpose: Cloud platform for running open-source AI models via a simple pay-per-second API, lowering the barrier to deploying models without managing GPU infrastructure
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-second based on GPU type used; no upfront commitment; pricing varies by model (e.g., Nvidia T4, A40, A100 tiers); free tier with limited credits for new users
features: Largest hosted catalog of open-source models with 50,000+ available via API
Simple REST API and Python/Node.js client libraries
Support for image, video, audio, text, and multimodal models
Cold-start optimized deployments with autoscaling to zero
Custom model deployment via Cog (open-source containerization tool)
Webhooks and async predictions for batch workloads
Version pinning for reproducible production deployments
Community model sharing and forking
platforms.best_for: Startups and indie developers who need instant API access to a wide variety of open-source models without DevOps overhead, especially for creative and generative AI use cases

platforms.name: Together AI
platforms.purpose: High-performance, low-cost LLM inference cloud with an OpenAI-compatible API, plus fine-tuning and training capabilities for open-weight models
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token pricing; among the lowest-cost options for LLM inference (e.g., Llama 3 models from $0.18/M tokens); no minimum spend; dedicated instances available for high-volume customers
features: OpenAI-compatible API for seamless migration from OpenAI endpoints
Lowest-cost inference for popular open-weight models including Llama, Mistral, Qwen, and DeepSeek
Managed fine-tuning on custom datasets with LoRA and full fine-tuning support
Serverless and dedicated deployment options
High-throughput inference with custom CUDA kernels and FlashAttention optimizations
Together Embeddings API for vector generation
Support for function calling, JSON mode, and long-context models
Enterprise SLAs and private deployments available
platforms.best_for: Cost-sensitive startups and enterprises building production LLM applications who need reliable, scalable, OpenAI-compatible inference at the lowest possible token cost

platforms.name: Fireworks AI
platforms.purpose: Ultra-fast LLM inference platform optimized for production workloads, offering serverless and dedicated deployments with a focus on speed, reliability, and function-calling capabilities
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token serverless pricing; dedicated deployments billed per GPU-hour; competitive with Together AI on cost; free tier available for prototyping
features: Industry-leading inference speed with sub-100ms time-to-first-token on many models
FireAttention proprietary inference engine for optimized throughput
OpenAI-compatible API with support for chat, completions, and embeddings
First-class support for function calling and structured JSON output
Serverless autoscaling with no cold-start penalty on popular models
Compound AI system support for multi-model pipelines
On-demand fine-tuned model deployment (bring your own LoRA adapter)
SOC 2 Type II compliance and enterprise security features
platforms.best_for: Production engineering teams requiring the fastest possible inference latency, reliable uptime, and advanced structured output features for customer-facing AI applications

platforms.name: AWS Bedrock
platforms.purpose: Fully managed AWS service that provides API access to a curated selection of leading foundation models from multiple providers, integrated natively with the AWS cloud ecosystem
platforms.model_count: 50+ foundation models from providers including Anthropic, Meta, Mistral, Stability AI, Amazon (Titan/Nova), Cohere, and AI21 Labs
platforms.pricing: Pay-per-token on-demand pricing; Provisioned Throughput for guaranteed capacity billed per model unit per hour; no infrastructure management costs; pricing varies significantly by model provider
features: Single API to access models from Anthropic Claude, Meta Llama, Mistral, Amazon Nova, Cohere, and others
Bedrock Agents for building multi-step agentic workflows with tool use
Knowledge Bases for RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) with native vector store integration
Model fine-tuning and continued pre-training on custom datasets
Guardrails for content filtering, PII redaction, and hallucination detection
Native integration with AWS IAM, VPC, CloudWatch, and S3
Model Evaluation for benchmarking models on custom datasets
Data never used to train base models; enterprise-grade data privacy
Cross-region inference for latency optimization and availability
platforms.best_for: Enterprises already invested in the AWS ecosystem that need managed, compliant, and scalable access to top foundation models with minimal infrastructure burden and native integration with AWS security and data services
